PlanetSide 2 will always hold a special place in my heart. Back in my school days, nothing beat the excitement of coming home to dive into this game with my friends. The game’s freedom in gameplay allowed us to create countless fun and chaotic memories that I'll never forget.

Even now, I occasionally revisit it, and it still captures the same magic (though sadly with fewer players). It feels like the game is nearing the end of its journey, but I’m grateful for everything it provided.

Thank you PlanetSide 2, for providing us with unforgettable adventures and memories.
Yep, even after so many years, it still has its amazing spirit. A unique experience you simply can't get anywhere else. Highly recommended

2 years and still going the game that has tons of players online and will always keep you busy as you sneak, fly, and shoot your way througth this war on a planet as you have team of pro's, and fools but the teamwork that goes into this game is funny and amazing feels like real stagey that goes can be really fun i plawed for a year now and this game is still going strong F2P and will always still be there!!!!!!!

Worst long term gaming experience so far. Played 420+ h only on steam (I have played the beta). I can't recommend this game because the devs unfortunately prefer one faction over the other two. You spend Money and a lot of time in this game just to get screwed over with a shitty patch rendering expensive weapons useless for example. 1/10 Wouldn't spent time/money again because this shit keeps happening.

It's been a while since I last played Planetside 2, but I wanted to share a recommended review based on my past experiences. I have so many fond memories of jumping in with large clans and taking part in absolutely massive battles on those huge maps. It was truly an amazing experience. Even though I can’t speak to how it is right now in 2025, I imagine it's likely still a fantastic game, especially if the player counts remain strong. If you're looking for that kind of large-scale, unforgettable combat, it’s definitely worth checking out. If you can't hit anything, be a medic - it's actually a really fun time.

If you want a game you can sink a lot of time into, look no further.
3 asymmetrical factions fight each other over continents in an endless war of attrition. Each with their own flavors and charm.
The amount of time one can put in this game is mind boggling, veteran players with 1000s of hours are still playing this one-of-a-kind game. There are so many ways to play, pilot, tanker, support, medic, assault, infiltrator, with a squad or an outfit, logistics, saboteur, ambush, base building, convoys, and more.
To top it all of, this game is nearing its 10 year anniversary, not many games live this long.
Simply put, there is no other game like this one, and nothing else comes close to it.

It does take alot of time to get into this game, but if your willing to put the time and effort into it. Its a blast.
Give and you shall recieve, even if you have to die over 1000 times to even understand what to do xD. As far as new players go, there are also tons of friendly senior community members that would be more than willing to help new players into the game.

I will say Ive met some really cool people on planetside 2 and its a great social expirience.

Why does the console version get less updates than the PC version? I don't get it.

Still fun though!
This game still looks great in 2024, and runs super well, basically on par with Apex in both regards. Absolutely worth giving a shot.

I've loved this game for over a decade. One of the most unique MMOFPS, if not the only. Unfortunately, as of the past few years, and the game has deteriorated. No major updates, dropping server populations, hackers, server lag and game bugs, etc. It's sad.

The thing that did it for me was hits not registering if you're lagging. How can you have a shooter game if you can't even get the shooting part consistent? (and no, I'm not using scripts or hacking.) If I can't even do the shooting part of a shooting game, the game has failed. This has been a growing issue for the past year, and now over 50% of my hits don't register. Sad to see such a great game fall from it's glory, although what can you expect from a game 10+ years old with several changing of hands in regards to dev teams.

Hoping for a Planetside 3, but realistically that ain't happening.

Its still one of the best FPS out there in my opinion balance of the three factions is good you can have any playstyle play knife only play sniper play shotgun, tank, pilot whatever.
you dont need to pay money weapons are only for specializing in one area e.g close quarters or ranged combat.
certs should be mostly spent on class abilities.
only critique i have is the implant system, which gives you a slight advantage over someone who might not have an implant, it takes ages to get a special implant i know its meant for late game but paying 300 certs for 3 implants which you might already have is bit pricey.

highly recommend getting it even if its old it still gets updated.
Absolutely brillant game. I strongly recomend this game if you are in search for a free to play, large scale combat, beautifully detailed game.

Love this game, despite changes from the original Planetside, Planetside 2 brings a different gameplay take on the open-world MMOFPS. I cannot, however in good conscience recommend playing the game at this time due to random crashing. I simply was checking sales on the store on multiple characters and the game will crash without an error every 2 or 3 minutes or so. Checking system logs states it's a fault and it is the same fault every single time. I have attempted integrity verification and this did nothing to resolve the random crashing. Don't play this now as it will not give a true representation of the game. Wait until they fix their faulting crash issue...

Honestly the most war feeling war game, bullets flying, missiles flying past your head every 5 seconds, snipers everywhere. This is more battlefield than battlefield. It has its balance issues and some of the vets are pretty damn toxic but when you get over them and just start playing the game the way you want to enjoy it, it's fun.

J to join combat!

You will die... a lot.

But why is this a Positive review you may ask.

Easy, even if you die a lot there are always other Players around that will do the same.
You depend on the others and the others rely on You!

Planetside 2 is no ordinary First Person Shooter, this Game is a FPS with a build in Community behind it.

You will never encouter boring NPCs, you will not always meet Players that are on your Experience Level, you will not always find Fights you can win.

There is no Match Making and this is how it works.

You will need to Communicate, you will need to make Strategies you will encounter other Humans... with your Friends.

I took...a near 6 year break from this game, at this time I finished university, found a job,then another...Times has passed, things have changed. This game is no exception. It is still a blast to play, too bad that time wasn't kind to it. Many have moved on, and good fights are too hard to find at times. I still think this game is worth the time to play it.

P.S. I still wish they let me change the damn Plane controll scheme on my mouse, number one wish since Open Beta 10 years ago...I'm not geting any younger, please let me FLY THE WAY I WANT TO FLY.

come back when they fix the hacking problem. right now its running rampant and making the game unplayable since one person can telport around knifing people or standing on point and sniping anyone who comes within a certain radius even through walls. at first it was a couple people but now the population of hackers are growing and so far they havent done anything to stop it. they may eventually but right now its a hacker fighting sim and if you are not hacking yourself there is no point in playing

Hard to learn and understand at first, but once you "get it" you'll be hooked.

Gameplay feels incredibly smooth. Looks and sounds amazing.

EDIT: 6 years later. I've met all of my best friends and worst enemies playing this game. Among the friends I've made, I've traveled across the country for a wedding and rehoused a friend's dog across 5 states. Planetside has changed my life.

A truly amazing game, I played Planetside 2 back when it came out in 2012 but recently came across it again on Steam and started playing again. Wish I hadn't, this game is completely addicting.The community is great and people in chat are always willing to help new players, The class system has diverse choices for all play styles, and you always have some role to play in the massive battles that unfold. Just remember to get involved in the community and you'll have a great time.
This game is great. Graphics are amazing. Feel like a endless battle. Four huge maps. Hard to get started but once you get the ball rolling you will spend hours playing, And it's free!
Absolutely 100% reccommend this game. The combat is fantastic, once you figure out what you're doing. The best part is, its not just a run and gun game. Strategy matters. It's phenominal.

My review was positive despite the recent infil rework, which i agree with

It's a game one of its own kind. Sure, developers have changed over time and at some point the game has stagnated vastly, it was the period when its playerbase dropped and negative reviews started to occur more and more. But at the same time, Planetside 2 provides an experience you won't find anywhere else.

All the low-res textures/graphics are compensated by a sheer amount & scale of the battlefield where air, navy, ground aspects are thrown into a fray.

Con side of this, is a bit of an abnormal amount of money the game wants you to put into. There's no free customization options and the only thing that it shared across all your characters/factions are camouflage patterns. The rest? If you bought a helmet from Stigma series for Terran faction, you won't have it by a miracle unlocked on other characters.

Game also includes subscription, with which, experience and certification points (in-game currency to unlock / upgrade weapons, modules for both weapons & vehicles, utilities) are doubled. Without them, it's a painful grind.

But the best part of this game, it's free to play and doesn't weight much so anyone can try it out without losing anything but a little bit of time to understand if it's something they want to focus on or not.

Really cannot believe this is a free game. The Multiplayer in this game is so addictive and it can have up to 50 people in one lobby. I would recommend PlaneSide 2 to anyone that likes huge maps and can fly around with Helicopter and cause havoc with a Juggernaut.

I don't have many hours in planetside 2, but I can tell you I've been keeping up with this game ever since it started all those years ago. The release was alright, then it started going down the confusion path where no one knew what the devs were doing with the game, with infrequent updates, this lasted for a long ass time. Then in came the carriers and since then, it's a constant stream of updates, events, and a surge of players. Awesome. I don't know who to thank for this at RGP, but whoever got the team on their feet to fix the game and not just let the game die is awesome. Thank you.

I am a new player who heard about the hype and thought that it was finally time to give this game a chance. I had expected it to feel old and dated, but I was incredibly surprised. This was a trip back to when games were good, back when the design was driven by ambition to see something that had never been done before, not by what gaming trend would make the most dollars for your shareholders.

In my few hours I have found so many intense fights and epic moments and I am only scratching the surface of the game with many of the deeper systems still looming as mysteries in my future. I am actively trying to recruit all of my friends to this hidden gem and if you are on the fence, I implore you to take the leap. There is no cost but all the lost sleep from loosing track of time!

I've been playing on and off for close to 10 years now which should speak for itself. There's really nothing like it. The size and scale of the maps and battles keeps me coming back and you've gotta love the dedication of the devs bringing in new, quality content this many years out from release. Sure BF and CoD look a lot better these days but it's still PS2 for me.
Fun game when you have a group of like minded people involved. Join an active outfit and you may have a good time. Playing with a coordinated group is key.

Love the magnitude of battles, from the little skirmish to the all out lasers and dakka flyuing around in big fields.
Adapts to all players, from the casual drop in drop out to the guild raid mentality.
The grind for new weapons and stuff is a bit rough,fast at first but slows down after the first 2k credits or so, but do what you want to do and you won't feel the burden of it.

Been with this one-of-a-kind game since 2012 with massive battles, interesting factions and faction-specific weaponry, and class types. Sad to see how much the player population has declined but the IP being turned over to multiple studios and the decisions each studio has made has slowly driven players away. Still some great fights during primetime, but it is a shadow of what it once was. As unbalanced as it may be right now or in the past, the game has been pretty enjoyable and I had a great time. Hope they release another Planetside game or re-release this one after fixes and modernizations.

7 years later and this game is still amazing! The main reason that this game is such a masterpiece is because it has no real competition. If a game similar to Planetside 2 were to come out and the devs even somewhat cared about it then it would easily cause Planetside 2 to die. This game is fun, has tons of potential, but the developers basically couldn't care less about this game. Hopefully the update next month will help the game grow. But I think the future looks bleak, and Daybreak Games is starting to lose money, their reputation for aggressive monetization, and their refusal to listen to their players will be the end of them. Honestly, it is sad to see what has become of a great game like Planetside 2. I really want this game to succeed, I love the idea of it. The Planetside 2 experience is unique but Daybreak doesn't know how to use that uniqueness to make the game better and attract new players. Overall, you should play Planetside 2 because there isn't anything else like it and I doubt that there will be for many years to come, but it is run by a company that doesn't care in the slightest about their community, their product, or anything else except earning that cash.

This game is great, absolute love it. Big scale war, lots of armory to choose from. Play as engineer, medic, sniper, MAX(basicly a fallout armor suit), light and heavy assult.

Some say its p2w, its maybe is it in some degree, but the weapons you are giving at start are good and even better that you pay for, and if you coop with a friend you almost unstoppable. Teamwork here does really turn the table on the battle ground.

But remeber choose faction wisely, NC is the heavy and slow, TR is the light and fast. And lastly VS is the best hit and run faction.

Don't listen to what the negative review say this game has one of the best online communities. Get into squads of up to 60 ppl, and then there is still more than that it is awesome EPIC and worth the time!

Excellent game, and FREE. You can pay for ingame content with real cash, but even without paying you can be equal to others that are paying, it will just consume more of your time.

Very interesting game, with finishing directives/getting experience points you also gain certification points that you can (and should) use for buying weapons/abilities. With that you have many ways to play/roles to focus in game so it can't be boring, except maybe when farming those certification points.

When you start playing this game, it will take some time to actually understand what the heck is going on in all those big battles, and how you actually "win". Another problem for begginers is to learn how to efficiently spend those hard-earned certification points depending on their playing style.

After you get used to this game, it is even more fun to play it

Give it a try; it is free.

No idea what to do? Play Engineer or Medic at first: you will earn a lot of XP and stay behind your allies, giving you a chance to see what others do without dying as often (you will die a lot).

Feel overwhelmed? Look for an outfit, they'll show you the ropes

How do you know which outfit is good?

Look around the map which outfits captured a lot of bases, apply to join these outfits.

DISCLAIMER: You still want to stay away from zergfits, like Angels of Death. If they have more than 1000 members, then better stay away. Additionally you can check outfit stats at http://www.planetside-universe.com/. Generally speaking I would recommend to go with an outfit that has less than 500 members, more than 40% activity rate within the last month and an average level above 60; those are the guys that you want to hang out with.

Great game, and not even pay to win. As long as you're okay with dying repeatedly at first I would recommend. What this game really needs is different weather, it gets boring seeing the same clear sky every time I get on.

This is probably one of the most underrated games in history. Great free-to-play game for sure.
Also, this is probably one of the few free-to-play games that is not pay-to-win.
Really deserves a much larger player base in my opinion, unlike most games.

Compared to other Games this Game reaches Battles on epic scales nobody would've ever thought that they were possible. Even if it's still bugged, not optimized and not completed it's pretty enjoyable and even more fun if you have a good outfit you can fight with.It is also being update every ~2-4weeks with some performance improvements, new weaponry you can choose from or just game balanceing. It gives you a lot of variety to choose from, you can stay in a tank for hours or just switch between infantry classes in a few seconds. The key is to stay together, be focused and stay prepared for your enemy's next turn.

I don't know how they managed to get a 13 year old game to run so poorly.

I remember playing this game 10+ years ago and it was a fairly demanding game back then but I had it running fairly well on a midrange GPU of the time, but now it's just ridiculous. I did not expect to have to search up "potato settings" for a 13 year old game when I have a computer several times more powerful than what I was running this on back then.

They've totally wrecked it.

10/10 would bang... again

I made this review 6 years ago when I was 14 and very not good at the game. This game has had so much up and down in what is coming close to a decade of existence. Right now, it's recapturing what made it so great in the first place while continuing to innovate new ways to enjoy the game. I strongly recommend this game to anyone who is willing to try it

This game, is fucking huge. Without explaining this game in a long paragraph from it's outfits to it being an MMOFPS, all I can say is it's enormous. The graphics are also incredible and intense to weaker computers, so there's that. I can't handle living a life on this one game because that's how I work, but if you do want to get into this game, you can either being a random pub like myself or actually get deeper than the surface and be a true member of your faction. Have fun.

How did I sleep on this game? It's 8 years after release and I'm just now discovering this game.
I'm a huge battlefield player ever since 1942. If you liked Battlefield 2142, this is the game for you.
Larger battles, bigger battlefields, and more amazing moments make this game worth playing in 2020.

This game has a learning curve. It's pretty big, but it won't put you off if you've played a Battlefield game.
They do a great job of giving you decent weapons when you start...but your abilities, and shields are garbage. Same with vehicles. You won't have any cool abilities or helpful things like cloaks or shields.

If you focus on one toon you'll be fine unlocking things for each class. If you're like me and want 1 from each...it's going to be annoying. The Free to play model can be frustrating.
The amount of time you'd have to spend to unlock a decent number of a guns is staggering. You pretty much need to pay for the subscription model if you're going to play this seriously. That said...you can always jump into a battle and have fun(unless you're getting rolled on). Try to find battles with even numbers. They're the most fun.

PlanetSide 2 is a blast! Huge battles, intense teamwork, and non-stop action it's chaos in the best way. Don’t mess up such a great game.

EDIT:

Honestly, it makes me really sad that this game might eventually die. PlanetSide 2 is one of those games that has something you just don’t see anymore. Seeing all the recent crashes and the state of the game really hurts, because it would be a damn shame to watch something this unique slowly disappear.

I’ve spent a lot of great hours in this game and genuinely had a great time playing it. That’s why, despite everything, I’m leaving a positive review. This game deserves to be remembered for the good times it gave people.
Great game. More fun with friends. Try starting out as a medic to get some fast certs and upgrade to a better weapon.
